So the glob eagerly includes Dashboard.vue, which imports AppLayout → AppSidebarLayout → AppSidebar → NavUser → UserMenuContent (missing). Let me verify Dashboard.vue's role. In createInertiaApp resolve uses import.meta.glob which creates lazy dynamic imports. Vite, when resolving the page component glob, transforms Dashboard.vue. But is Dashboard.vue lazily loaded? import.meta.glob without eager:true produces dynamic imports, so Dashboard.vue is loaded lazily on navigation, not on initial page load. 

But wait — our crawler found Dashboard.vue in the graph from app.ts because import.meta.glob generates `import('/resources/js/pages/Dashboard.vue')` statements in the transformed output. These are lazy though. So MainPage home page load doesn't actually fetch Dashboard.vue at runtime. The 500 on NavUser only happens when Dashboard route is visited, which doesn't exist.

So does the home page actually work? The crawl eagerly fetched every module including lazily-imported ones. That's not what a browser does. The browser only loads what's needed for the MainPage component. Dashboard.vue is lazy.
